privacy.paragraph3: {app} is a service for Instagram Business or Creator account owners to schedule content, reply to direct messages (DMs) and comments, and draft content with AI assistance through Meta’s official API. Each user signs up with an email and password, then connects one Instagram account they own. The service is operated by {app}, which can be contacted at <emailLink>{email}</emailLink>.
privacy.paragraph5: User account: email address and password. The login system stores passwords as hashes, never in their original form.
privacy.paragraph6: Your Instagram account: account ID, username, account type, approved permissions, token expiry, and access token. Tokens are stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM).
privacy.paragraph7: Instagram profile on first connection: to populate your brand kit, {app} reads the connected account’s name, bio, profile photo, and captions from up to 12 recent posts. The profile photo is saved as your brand logo, and images from the 3 most recent posts are copied as design references. You can change or delete all of these on the Brand page.
privacy.paragraph8: User content: photos, captions, post schedules, content ideas, and IDs and links for published posts, along with records of publishing failures.
privacy.paragraph9: Post statistics: for the Analytics page, {app} reads posts from the connected account from the last 90 days (ID, type, caption, link, thumbnail, and publication time) along with their insights: views, reach, likes, comments, shares, saves, and total interactions. Only the latest figures are stored; posts deleted from Instagram are removed on the next sync.
privacy.paragraph10: Direct messages: if you send a DM to an Instagram account connected to {app}, Meta forwards your Instagram ID scoped to that account, username, name, profile photo link, message ID, text content, and timestamp to this service. Profile photo links are refreshed no more than once every 3 days and are used only to display inbox avatars. Attachments such as photos and videos are not stored. The account owner’s messages in the conversation, whether sent through {app} or directly through Instagram, are also stored so the conversation can be read in full, along with when the owner last opened it. DMs are not stored while the account owner’s subscription is inactive.
privacy.paragraph11: Post comments: if you comment on a post from an account connected to {app}, the service stores the comment ID, post ID, your Instagram ID and username, comment text, timestamp, the comment it replies to, and whether it is hidden. Comments are received from Meta when posted and fetched again from posts from the last 30 days when the owner opens the Replies page, so the owner can read, reply (in comments or once via DM), hide, or delete them. Comments deleted from Instagram are removed on the next fetch.
privacy.paragraph12: Brand references and website Assets: content from up to 11 pages of the brand’s website, images the user selects to import into Assets, and public posts from other Instagram business or creator accounts selected as design references, along with their account names and links. Those other accounts’ names, bios, and follower counts are displayed only during search and are not stored.
privacy.paragraph13: AI request history: content sent to AI and its results, model, status, duration, and credits used. This is stored to calculate usage and troubleshoot issues.
privacy.paragraph14: Payments: amount, status, Mayar payment link, and subscription period.
privacy.paragraph15: Cookies: login session cookies to keep you signed in and a `locale` preference cookie to remember your chosen language (ID/EN). {app} does not use advertising, tracking, or third-party analytics cookies.
privacy.paragraph17: Data is used only to provide features to the user who owns it: publishing scheduled posts, displaying and replying to DMs and comments, notifying the owner of new messages or comments, showing post performance, and drafting captions and images. One user’s data cannot be viewed by another user. Every DM and comment reply is sent by the account owner themselves. {app} does not send bulk or unsolicited messages.
privacy.paragraph19: Meta (Instagram): to publish posts, retrieve profiles and post statistics, read comments, send DM and comment replies, and hide or delete comments at the account owner’s request.
privacy.paragraph20: Mayar: your email and invoice amount, to process subscription payments. Mayar processes your card or bank account details; these never reach {app}.
privacy.paragraph21: AI providers through 9Router: topics, captions, brand information, brand website content, the user’s Instagram username, name, bio and captions, reference images, and product or website images selected for the catalog or content are sent to generate drafts. DM and comment content (up to the last 10 messages, plus the post caption for comments) is sent only when the account owner presses the AI button to draft a reply, without the sender’s ID or profile photo.
privacy.paragraph22: Data is not sold or used for advertising.
privacy.paragraph24: Data is stored in Supabase databases and file storage managed by {app}. The dashboard requires login, every request reads only the signed-in user’s data, the database is not publicly accessible, and files are accessed only through signed links that expire after 1 hour.
privacy.paragraph25: {app} admins can view users’ emails, sign-up and last-login dates, connected Instagram usernames, subscription status, payment history, and AI request counts and statuses (but not their content) for customer support and billing. Admins can reset passwords, suspend accounts, or delete accounts, and each action is logged.
privacy.paragraph27: Access tokens are deleted when the user disconnects their account. You can still disconnect from the Settings page while your subscription is inactive. Other data is kept for as long as the user account exists or until deleted on request (see <deletionLink>Data Deletion</deletionLink>). Admin action records, including the affected account’s email, are retained after account deletion as an audit trail.
privacy.paragraph28: Users may connect only Instagram accounts they own or are authorized to manage, and are responsible for the content and replies they publish.
privacy.paragraph29: Use is subject to the Meta Platform Terms, Instagram Terms of Use, and Instagram Community Guidelines. Spam, bulk messages, and unsolicited messages are prohibited.
privacy.paragraph30: Prices, active periods, and allowances follow the plan selected in the payment summary.
privacy.paragraph31: Payments received are non-refundable unless the service is unusable due to a fault on {app}’s part.
privacy.paragraph32: The service is provided as is, without any warranties.
privacy.paragraph33: Changes to this policy and these terms are announced by updating this page and its effective date.
privacy.paragraph34: {app} users who wish to delete their account and all its data (connections, posts, photos, DMs, comments, brand kit, AI history, and payment history):
privacy.paragraph35: Email <deleteLink>{email}</deleteLink> with the subject “Hapus data” from your account’s email address.
privacy.paragraph36: Your account and data will be deleted within 30 days of receiving the email, and you will receive confirmation.
privacy.paragraph37: You can also revoke app access anytime: disconnect in Settings (or Subscription while your subscription is inactive), then remove {app} in Instagram (Settings and activity → Website permissions → Apps and websites).
privacy.paragraph38: DM senders and commenters: if you have sent a DM or commented on an account managed with {app} and want your data deleted, email the same address with the subject “Hapus data” and include your Instagram username. Your conversations, messages, and comments will be deleted within 30 days of receiving the email. You can also request a copy of your data at the same email address.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.planPrice: {name} plan: {price} per month before duration discounts, paid in advance through Mayar. There is no automatic renewal: access stops at the end of the period until renewed, and scheduled posts are not published while the subscription is inactive.
privacy.planCredits: The {name} plan includes {credits} AI credits per month, including for multi-month purchases. Unused credits do not roll over to the next month. Purchase terms are saved at checkout.
